속성.title: 연회비 면제 및 계약 해지에 따른 반환

Neo4j Browser에 붙여 넣기.질의: MATCH (n:__Entity__ {generation: 'gen-lab-v1-3bfc2695'}) WHERE n.embedding IS NOT NULL RETURN count(n) AS 개수
MATCH (n:__Entity__ {generation: 'gen-lab-v1-3bfc2695'}) RETURN labels(n) AS 라벨, n.embedding[0..5] AS 벡터_앞5개, size(n.embedding) AS 차원 LIMIT 3

Neo4j Browser에 붙여 넣기.설명: 벡터 검색: 엔티티 하나와 뜻이 가까운 엔티티 3개
Neo4j Browser에 붙여 넣기.질의: MATCH (a:__Entity__ {generation: 'gen-lab-v1-3bfc2695'}) WITH a LIMIT 1 CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('kg_entity_embedding', 6, a.embedding) YIELD node, score WHERE node.generation = 'gen-lab-v1-3bfc2695' AND elementId(node) <> elementId(a) RETURN score, labels(node) AS 라벨, apoc.map.removeKey(properties(node), 'embedding') AS 속성 ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 3
